description: project.godot and the audio bus layout. A write with an editor open on the project goes through the editor. Operations: get: read one setting, or every setting under prefix; set (needs setting, value); unset (needs setting): take a setting out, so the engine default holds; add_autoload (needs name, path); remove_autoload (needs name); set_main_scene (needs scenePath); add_input_action (needs actionName, events): register an input action and its events, or rebind one that exists; remove_input_action (needs actionName); enable_plugin (needs pluginName); disable_plugin (needs pluginName); add_audio_bus (needs busName); remove_audio_bus (needs busName): remove a bus, sending what sent to it on to where it sent; set_audio_bus_effect (needs busIndex, effectIndex, effectType): put an effect in a slot on a bus; set_audio_bus_volume (needs busIndex): set a bus's volume, mute, solo or bypass; rename_audio_bus (needs busName, newBusName): rename an audio bus, with the sends naming it; set_audio_bus_send (needs busIndex, sendTo).

actionName.description: Such as "jump". For ops add_input_action, remove_input_action.

busIndex.description: The audio bus, by index. For ops set_audio_bus_effect, set_audio_bus_volume, set_audio_bus_send.

busName.description: The bus, by name. add_audio_bus: the new one. For ops add_audio_bus, remove_audio_bus, rename_audio_bus.

bypassEffects.description: Skip the bus's effects. For op set_audio_bus_volume.

deadzone.description: Default: the rebound action's, or 0.5. For op add_input_action.

effectIndex.description: Slot on the bus, where an effect of another class is replaced and one of the same class stays with its settings. One past the last adds one. For op set_audio_bus_effect.

effectType.description: Effect class, such as "AudioEffectReverb". For op set_audio_bus_effect.

enabled.description: set_audio_bus_effect: whether the effect is on, a kept one too. Default true. add_autoload refuses false. For ops add_autoload, set_audio_bus_effect.

events.description: The events that trigger the action, each bound to every device. For op add_input_action.

axis.description: Joypad axes: the index, 0 and 1 the left stick, 2 and 3 the right, 4 and 5 the triggers.

button.description: Mouse and joypad buttons. Mouse: 1 left, 2 right, 3 middle, 4 to 7 the wheel, 8 and 9 the side buttons. Joypad: the button index, 0 being A.

keycode.description: Keys: the key name, such as "Space" or "W".

physical.description: Keys: bind by key position rather than what it types.

from.description: Where to read. disk (default) reads project.godot. editor asks the open editor, unsaved changes included. For op get.

global.description: Make the name a global variable. Default true. For op add_autoload.

mute.description: Mute the bus, or unmute it. For op set_audio_bus_volume.

name.description: The autoload's name. add_autoload replaces one already registered. For ops add_autoload, remove_autoload.

newBusName.description: The name the bus takes. Buses sending to it follow, and every scene and resource line giving a node the old bus is rewritten. A script naming it in a string is left as it is and listed under namedInScripts. For op rename_audio_bus.

parentBusIndex.description: Index of the bus the new bus sends to. Default 0, Master. The new bus goes right after it, so every later bus moves one along. For op add_audio_bus.

path.description: The autoload's script or scene. For op add_autoload.

pluginName.description: Folder under addons/. For ops enable_plugin, disable_plugin.

prefix.description: Answer every setting whose name starts with this, such as "debug/gdscript/warnings/", instead of one. For op get.

scenePath.description: Scene file, such as "scenes/main.tscn". For op set_main_scene.

sendTo.description: The bus to send to, by name. It must come before this bus. For op set_audio_bus_send.

setting.description: Setting path, such as "display/window/size/viewport_width". For ops get, set, unset.

solo.description: Solo the bus. Buses not soloed are silent. For op set_audio_bus_volume.

value.description: The value, fitted to the registered type: an enum takes its name or number, vectors are {"x": 1, "y": 2}, a colour may be "#ff8000". Infinity is {"_type": "float", "value": "inf"}, and "" writes an empty string. An undeclared setting is written as given, so a packed array is tagged {"_type": "PackedStringArray", "value": ["res://a/"]}. For op set.

volumeDb.description: Volume in decibels. For op set_audio_bus_volume.
